_comment: One entry per fixture in test/fixtures. `host` is substituted for
location.hostname so the per-site table in the script is exercised the way
it would be on the live page.
`pdf` assertions are only checked with --pdf; they render the generated
document the way the print dialog would and read the result back with
pdftotext. page1EndsWith is what caught the long-gap bug: a tall hero plus
orphans:3 pushed a whole paragraph to page 2 and left half a page blank.
Do NOT assert figure counts on wikipedia (varies run to run) or hero on
microsoft (its lead image loads inconsistently in a headless render).
